(2) HEAT-MAP -- persistent MS hot/cold + clustering + persistent snapshots (Andrew: 'maybe hourly basis') feeding a HEAT-INDEX; reuses the HEATMAP engine (HEATMAP_OBJECT build-complete) over the MS slice of the expanded graph. (3) COMP-TOOLS + INDEX (the NEW layer, the headline deliverable) -- MS-specific comp-tools: a findability 'comp-which for the doc-cloud' + heat-index-directed tools, so AGENTS FIND WHAT THEY NEED FASTER when working in the MS space. Reuses: the globgrph derive pipeline + the live m365 gateway Graph API (NFRA_OPLMCP) + the HEATMAP analytics engine + the comp-tool/comp-which pattern (NFRA_COMPRAIL). PRD: CTO carves/extends from NFRA_EXPAND_PRD (NFRA_EXPAND retains Strand B auth-edge + Strand C non-MS repo/MCP heat-map).
